boundaries.posting: no social post, draft, upload, schedule, or publish action is authorized by this packet
boundaries.photos_library: do not move Photos.app library or source photos
boundaries.editor_source_of_truth: merge series.plan.json with editor_overrides.json, never mutate series.plan.json from the editor
boundaries.final_exports: generated jpgs under renders/ are explicit render outputs and may be stale when editor overrides are newer

modes.edit: text box is active: drag to move, resize handle changes width, double-click edits text inline, fit text adjusts width/font size for readability, arrow keys nudge selected text
modes.media: backdrop is active: drag the canvas to pan crop focal_x/focal_y, search or pick visuals, adjust zoom/focal sliders
modes.export: render actions are explicit and are the only place final jpgs are rewritten

editor_behavior.navigation: post selection resets the text search; slide search filters the selected post by slide text, goal, lesson refs, and visual id without writing overrides
editor_behavior.review_queue: slide rail includes non-destructive filters for all, needs work, render, and readable; badges are derived from current platform freshness plus text readability
editor_behavior.readability_policy: show a non-blocking text fit meter from rendered line count and frame height; fit text may update text_box.w, text_box.x, and text_box.font_size but never rewrites slide copy
editor_behavior.platform_sync: copy to instagram/tiktok is explicit; it scales text_box coordinates from the active platform to the other platform, copies crop zoom/focal point, autosaves overrides, and leaves final jpg rendering gated
editor_behavior.save_policy: drag/type changes update the live editor and autosave overrides; final exports remain unchanged until render
editor_behavior.undo_policy: undo restores the previous slide/platform state and writes that restoration to editor_overrides.json
editor_behavior.state_contract: coordinates are platform pixels: ig 1080x1350, tt 1080x1920

posts.title: learn durable workflows
posts.caption: durable agent workflows are the production skill behind agents that can actually finish work. learn persisted state, idempotent tool calls, approval gates, traces, and reconciliation.

slides.text: if you're learning agents, learn durable workflows: persisted state, idempotent tools, approval gates, traces. that's what turns demos into production systems
slides.plan_text: if you're learning agents, learn durable workflows: persisted state, idempotent tools, approval gates, traces. that's what turns demos into production systems

slides.text: a real agent stores goal, step, event history, tool results, approvals, budget, and stop conditions so it can resume after crashes or human delays

posts.title: tool calls are commands
posts.caption: agent tool calls should be treated like commands with lifecycle, policy, idempotency, audit, and compensation. the model proposes, the system disposes.

slides.plan_text: treat agent tool calls like commands: proposed, validated, approved, executing, succeeded, failed, compensated

slides.text: the model proposes. the orchestrator owns lifecycle. policy owns permission. workers own side effects. the database owns truth

posts.title: idempotency for agents
posts.caption: idempotency for agents means retries can happen without duplicate real-world effects. stable keys, activity records, provider ids, and reconciliation matter more than vibes.

slides.text: learn idempotency if you want real agents. retries are normal. duplicate side effects are the production failure
slides.plan_text: learn idempotency if you want real agents. retries are normal. duplicate side effects are the production failure

slides.text: create the idempotency key before the side effect. store it with activity state. pass it to the provider when possible
slides.plan_text: create the idempotency key before the side effect. store it with activity state. pass it to the provider when possible

slides.text: keys usually need workflow id, step id, tool name, and version. arg hashes help, but step ids are safer
slides.plan_text: keys usually need workflow id, step id, tool name, and version. arg hashes help, but step ids are safer

slides.text: timeout after a provider call means unknown. mark it unknown, query the provider, then retry only if needed
slides.plan_text: timeout after a provider call means unknown. mark it unknown, query the provider, then retry only if needed

slides.text: test this by crashing after the side effect and before state update. rerun. it should not send, charge, or open twice

slides.text: top answer: queues deliver tasks. workflow state plus idempotent activities keeps retries safe

posts.title: queue vs workflow
posts.caption: queue vs workflow engine for agents: queues deliver work, workflows track business progress. use the smallest durable system that survives the failure shape.

slides.text: if an agent has approvals, payments, bookings, repo edits, emails, or scheduled follow-ups, think workflow state
slides.plan_text: if an agent has approvals, payments, bookings, repo edits, emails, or scheduled follow-ups, think workflow state

slides.text: a queue can deliver the task. it does not know if the business process completed, expired, compensated, or got stuck
slides.plan_text: a queue can deliver the task. it does not know if the business process completed, expired, compensated, or got stuck

slides.text: use cron for one safe periodic job. use a queue worker for one short idempotent task with no coordination
slides.plan_text: use cron for one safe periodic job. use a queue worker for one short idempotent task with no coordination

slides.text: use a custom db workflow for a few steps. store current state, append events, schedule activities, resume by signal
